articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset

article.story: NORTH ANDOVER, Mass. -- — Kyrone Alexander’s 23 points helped Boston University defeat Merrimack 65-60 on Wednesday. Alexander had eight rebounds and three steals for the Terriers (5-1). Sam Hughes scored 14 points, shooting 3 for 10 (3 for 9 from 3-point range) and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line. Azmar Abdullah shot 2 for 9 (2 for 7 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 10 points. Denver Anglin led the way for the Warriors (1-4) with 17 points. Merrimack also got 15 points from AJ Lesburt Jr. Eli Wilborn finished with 11 points. Hughes scored 11 points in the first half for Boston University, who led 32-29 at halftime. Alexander’s 17-point second half helped Boston University close out the five-point victory. Up next Boston University’s next game is Saturday against Columbia at home. Merrimack plays Vermont on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
